description:
Workspace-wide canonical-template hygiene sweep across all 8 extension-server crates (mail, chat, calendars, tasks, contacts, filenode, sharing, metadata). Bundles 5 deferred per-crate review findings that were filed against jmap-metadata-server but identified as workspace-wide canonical-template propagation needs:

## Deferred-from-JMAP-ayoz children

1. **bd:JMAP-ayoz.22 (P1)** — `pub use jmap_server::ClosureHandler` re-export in every extension-server lib.rs leaks foundation type ownership through the extension's public API. Verified present in all 8 siblings. Fix: drop the re-export across all 8 extension-servers; consumers reach for jmap_server::ClosureHandler directly.

2. **bd:JMAP-ayoz.23 (P1)** — `MemoryError(pub String)` public tuple field locks error representation. Same shape in canonical jmap-mail-server::memory::MemoryError. Fix: make the inner field private, add `pub fn message(&self) -> &str` accessor, add `#[non_exhaustive]`.

3. **bd:JMAP-ayoz.24 (P2)** — `MemoryBackend` struct missing `#[non_exhaustive]` across all 8 sibling crates. Fix: add the attribute uniformly.

4. **bd:JMAP-ayoz.36 (P1)** — `MemoryBackend::objects_mut` helper silently `known_accounts.insert`s on every call, creating phantom-account surface even after the per-create fix in bd:JMAP-ayoz.2. Workspace-wide cookie-cut in 7 of 8 siblings (filenode uses a different shape). Three fix options enumerated in the bead description.

5. **bd:JMAP-ayoz.7 (P1)** — `QueryObject::Comparator = serde_json::Value` in jmap-metadata-types::backend is a control-surface escape vs the typed comparator pattern in jmap-mail-types (EmailComparator, MailboxComparator). Decompose into type-crate (typed MetadataComparator + MetadataSortKey enum) and server-crate (handler shim validates) children. Pre-1.0 API break.

## Canonical-first propagation rule

Per workspace AGENTS.md "Canonical Templates", each finding must land in jmap-mail-server first (the canonical extension-server template), then propagate to the 7 sibling crates in the same pass. Decompose into one child per finding × one wire-up per sibling (~5 × 7 = 35 child beads, give-or-take where filenode's shape diverges).

## Out of scope

- The pre-existing rustdoc gap in metadata-server (newly filed) and the parallel jmap-sharing-server gap at bd:JMAP-ha4n — these are doc-fix beads, not canonical-template hygiene.
- bd:JMAP-ayoz.14 (negative-position cast hygiene) and bd:JMAP-ayoz.28 (id-invariant) — those are human-labeled judgment calls, not workspace-canonical drift; they stay in their own beads.

## Acceptance

Per child bead: cargo fmt + clippy + test + doc clean for the touched crate. Workspace cargo test --workspace clean on the final propagation commit. The 5 source review findings (.7, .22, .23, .24, .36) close when their per-sibling sweeps finish.
title: Workspace canonical hygiene: extension-server MemoryBackend / MemoryError / ClosureHandler re-export shape
